name: nginx-multisite
description: Provides Nginx multi-site web serving for three cluster-local hostnames, including per-site document roots, virtual-host configuration, TLS certificates, static content, and host security hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, Fedora-specific runtime and log directories, configuration, and service enablement.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys the FastAPI tutorial application by installing Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, cloning the application, creating its virtual environment and database, configuring environment settings, and managing it with systemd.
